Satsuma (satsuma.xyz), a San Francisco blockchain data-indexing/subgraph platform founded in March 2022 by Jonathan Kau (CEO) and Dan Li. Raised a $5M seed co-led by Initialized Capital and Archetype (April 2023). Alchemy acquired Satsuma in Sept 2023 (terms not disclosed); it became Alchemy Subgraphs and all six full-time employees joined Alchemy (The Block). Note: the SPC URL slug misspells the acquirer as 'alchemly'.
